id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the AT581x component. Useful when multiple instances of this component are defined.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

frequency.docs:
**enum**: Any of the possible frequencies (5696, 5715, 5730, 5748, 5765, 5784, 5800, 5819, 5836, 5851, 5869, 5888) in MHz. Defaults to `5800MHz`.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

hw_frontend_reset.docs:
**boolean**: If set to true, a reset of the analog frontend will be performed before changing other options. Ignored if not set or set to `false`. Upon applying the settings a frontend reset will be performed anyway, this is only useful if the sensor is not answering or locked up.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the sensor on which settings should be changed. If only one radar is defined, this is optional.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

power_consumption.docs:
**int**: Any of the possible power profile (48, 56, 63, 70, 77, 91, 105, 115, 40, 44, 47, 51, 54, 61, 68, 78) in µA

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

poweron_selfcheck_time.docs:
**int**: The delay to perform self check and calibration on power on. Recommended not to change this

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

protect_time.docs:
**int**: The delay after an end-of-trigger event where the detection will not trigger anymore. Max 65535ms

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

sensing_distance.docs:
**int**: A unitless number, in range 0-1023, specifying the maximum distance to detect motion

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

stage_gain.docs:
**int**: The analog gain to use for threshold test. Any value in range 0-12, with 12 being the lowest gain and 0 the highest

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

trigger_base.docs:
**int**: The delay while a detection must be active to change the state of the sensor. Max 65535ms

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

trigger_keep.docs:
**int**: The delay that the output will stay high after a detection event. This is usually what you want to change.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

settings.docs: > [!WARNING] > The hardware frontend reset option is only required to reset the frontend in case it is struck, before sending the > new configuration. However, a frontend reset is always performed after changing the settings.

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I2C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) if you want to use multiple I2C buses.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Necessary if you want to define multiple instances of this component.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*

at581x_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the AT581x component defined above. Required when multiple instances of the `at581x` component are defined.

*See also: [AirTouch AT581x Radar](https://esphome.io/components/at581x#configuration-variables)*
